title: A builder battery's record (RD-10, RD-26, RD-28)
description: Written by the builder's battery for one module's content and handed to battery_complete@1 as its reference: python tools/receipts.py battery --module MOD-NN --record <this file>. `manifest` is that content's digest (python tools/receipts.py manifest MOD-NN).

commit.description: The committed tree the battery ran on (RD-10: commit first).

claim.description: The claim this mutation targets (RD-26): a base case, a refusal, or a test's stated claim; or a prior K7 finding's shape.

restore_verified.description: The restore was verified against HEAD (git diff --quiet).

replant.description: For a kill at build only: the compiler-evading re-plant, which must die by TEST (RD-10).

no_new_claims.description: An empty battery says why: the change adds or changes no claim (RD-26).
